# Bismillah Pakhi & Aquarium (বিসমিল্লাহ পাখি এন্ড অ্যাকোয়ারিয়াম) — Full Documentation

## 2. Product & Livestock Catalog

### 2.1 Birds (পাখি)
- Budgerigar (বাজরিগার পাখি): Australian budgies in various mutations (Rainbow, Lutino, Albino, Spangle). Active, hardy, great for beginners.
- Cockatiel (ককাটেল পাখি): Lutino, Pearl, Grey, Pied, and Albino mutations. Whistling and companion pet birds.
- Lovebird (লাভবার্ড পাখি): Peach-faced, Fischer, and Masked lovebirds. High energy, affectionate pairs.
- Finches (ফিঞ্চ): Zebra finch, Society finch, Gouldian finch. Low maintenance flock birds.
- Sun Conure (সান কনুর): Highly intelligent, bright yellow/orange plumage, playful and trainable companion birds.
- Rare Exotic Birds: Blue and Gold Macaw (ম্যাকাও পাখি) available via verified pre-booking.

### 2.2 Aquarium & Fish (অ্যাকোয়ারিয়াম ও মাছ)
- Live Fishes: Betta Fighter Fish (Halfmoon, Crowntail, Dumbo Ear), Goldfish (Oranda, Black Moor, Ranchu), Guppy (Albino Full Red, Blue Moscow), Koi Carp, Angel Fish, Neon Tetra.
- Aquascaping Supplies: Natural driftwoods, Seiryu stones, aquarium soil (ADA, Amazonia), silica sand, tweezers, scissors.
- Equipment: Sobo / SunSun Hang-On Back (HOB) filters, internal submersible filters, high-efficiency sponge filters, USB air pumps, full-spectrum LED clip lights.

### 2.3 Feeds & Nutrition (খাবার ও পুষ্টি)
- Bird Feeds: 12-item premium seed mixes (Millet, Canary seed, Sunflower, Oats, Safflower, Hemp), ZuPreem fruit blend pellets, Cuttlefish bone for calcium, mineral blocks.
- Fish Feeds: Hikari Micro Pellets, Optimum tropical fish flakes, spirulina granules, tubifex worm cubes.

## 3. Customer Care & Service Model
1. WhatsApp Live Video Inspection:
   Customers can request a real-time WhatsApp video call to inspect bird health, feather condition, behavior, fish coloration, and tank setups before completing any purchase or visiting the store.
2. In-Store Consultation:
   Direct in-person visits to the physical store in Chuadanga to see birds and aquariums in a clean, hygienic environment.
3. Responsible Pet Ownership:
   Guidance provided on minimum cage dimensions, balanced diets (avoiding 100% sunflower seed diets), water conditioning (eliminating chlorine/chloramine), and temperature management.

## 4. Operational Policies
- Dead On Arrival (DOA) Guarantee:
  For localized shipments within allowable regional transit, any mortality requires an unedited video opening of the intact transport package within 30 minutes of arrival.
- Safe Transport:
  Live birds and fishes are packaged in breathable, stress-reducing, temperature-insulated transport boxes.
- Store Hours:
  Open 7 days a week, 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM (Asia/Dhaka timezone).
